Unlearning Rise:

Assumption: "Rise is proof of merit."
Reality: Rise is a rigged lottery—60% of Fortune 500 CEOs come from just 12 elite universities (Brookings, 2020), and 40% of promotions go to the most visible, not the most skilled (Stanford, 2023).

Assumption: "Rise means security."
Reality: The higher you climb, the faster you fall—78% of executives report chronic burnout (Deloitte, 2022), and the average tenure of a CEO has dropped to 5 years (Harvard Business Review, 2021).
